title: A finite thermal window is not a continuous error guarantee
statement: Two-node exact segment propagation and analytic extrema are evaluated at32 listed fill/volume/q corners for24h schedules, starting at a prepared298.15K state. With total k5N/m,K.005W/K, common/opposed disturbances5013.62/6888.42Pa lose the5000Pa certificate. K.020 gives4268.54/4775.33Pa at those corners, while doubling total stiffness to10 removes that window. Useful1A heating assigns .0408488W adversely to one node. No continuous-error/arbitrary-environment proof or high-K/low-k assembly is supplied.
